lines: you finished your plate
because i was starving?
SCHOOL SAYS THAT SLEEPING IS IMPORTANT
THEN WHY THEY WAKE UP US IN 6 AM TO GO TO SCHOOL?
So robots with Artificial Intelligence can hold conversations, and play chess
but can't check the "I am not a robot" checkbox?
SO, IN YOUR COUNTRY YOU CELEBRATE MOTHERS FOR A DAY, AND YOU CELEBRATE SHARKS FOR A WEEK?
YOU MEAN TO TELL ME YOU HATE MY POLITICAL MEMES
BUT YOUR STUPID HENTAI MEMES ARE PERFECTLY FINE?
SO, YOU'RE TELLING ME THAT YOU HAVE LARGE BOWLS OF CLEAN, FRESH, SELF-REFILLING WATER
AND YOU POOP IN THEM?
SO IN YOUR COUNTRY PEOPLE DIE OF EATING TOO MUCH FOOD?
SO YOU MEAN TO TELL ME
LITTLE RED RIDING HOOD COULDN'T FIGURE OUT A TALKING WOLF IN DRAG WASN'T HER GRANDMOTHER?
SO FEMINISTS DON'T NEED A MAN TO TAKE CARE OF THEM
BUT THEY NEED THE GOVERNMENT TO PAY FOR THEIR BIRTH CONTROL?
SO YOU DRIVE TO THE GYM TO WALK ON A TREDMILL
SO YOU'RE SAYING YOU WANT TO START A SECOND CIVIL WAR
BE CAUSE YOU ARE OFFENDED BY THE FIRST ONE?
SO, IT'S SECRET ADMIRER WHEN YOU ARE YOUNG, AND STALKER WHEN YOU ARE OLDER?
SO IF AN IDIOT POINTS A GUN AT A COP YOU GET MAD WHEN THE COP SHOOTS HIM?
SO YOU'RE PROTESTING FOR "RIGHTS"
THAT YOU ALREADY HAVE?
SO YOU'RE TELLING ME YOU FREEZE WATER SO THAT YOU CAN ADD WATER TO YOUR WATER
SO YOU TELLING ME
YOU HAD TO FINISH YOUR DINNER BECAUSE OF ME?
YOU'RE TELLING ME YOU DON'T COOK, CLEAN OR LOOK AFTER YOUR KIDS YET YOU'RE STILL "BUSY"
SO YOU'RE TELLING ME THAT SOMEONE OFFERED YOU FOOD, AND YOU TURNED IT DOWN
BECAUSE YOU HAD RECENTLY BRUSHED YOUR TEETH?
SO YOU'RE TELLING ME I'M FAMOUS BUT I'M STILL STARVING
"I WANNA HAPPY MEAL" "YOU SHOULD BE HAPPY TO GET A MEAL"

meaning.meaning_en: This meme uses the image of a child with a skeptical, unimpressed expression to mock absurd, illogical, or hypocritical statements. The first text box usually presents a ridiculous claim or a confusing situation, while the second box (often left empty or containing a rhetorical question) highlights the sheer disbelief and the lack of logic in the premise.
meaning.meaning_de: Dieses Meme nutzt das Bild eines skeptisch und unbeeindruckt dreinblickenden Kindes, um absurde, illogische oder heuchlerische Aussagen zu verspotten. Der erste Textbereich präsentiert in der Regel eine lächerliche Behauptung oder eine verwirrende Situation, während der zweite Bereich (oft leer oder mit einer rhetorischen Frage) die pure Ungläubigkeit und den Mangel an Logik im Ausgangspunkt hervorhebt.
situations_en: Wait, so you pay for the internet to download the internet?
My boss said I can work from home, but I have to be in the office.
I deleted the file to save space, but the trash is full.
Why is the 'delete' button on the right side of the screen?
I bought a new phone to get better battery life, now I have to buy a new charger.
situations_de: Warte, du zahlst also fürs Internet, um das Internet herunterzuladen?
Mein Chef sagte, ich kann von zu Hause arbeiten, aber ich muss im Büro sein.
Ich habe die Datei gelöscht, um Speicherplatz zu sparen, aber der Papierkorb ist voll.
Warum ist die 'Löschen'-Taste auf der rechten Seite des Bildschirms?
Ich habe mir ein neues Handy gekauft, um die Akkulaufzeit zu verbessern, jetzt muss ich einen neuen Lader kaufen.
